# PyroManiac



## page
The page: its route, title, and filters. A module with this section is a page
(`PyroManiac.Info.page?/1`). A module without it is not a page: it declares
views and searches that the pages of the application reuse, and it has no route.


### Nested DSLs
 * [extra_action](#page-extra_action)
   * render
 * [description](#page-description)





### Options

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`route`](#page-route){: #page-route .spark-required} | `String.t` |  | The URL path of the page (e.g. `"/recipes"`). It starts with `/`. A renderer uses it for the route declarations. A navigation item or a command with `page` opens this route; the navigation does not set it. |
| [`title`](#page-title){: #page-title } | `String.t` |  | Page title used for the document title and rendered as a page header. Defaults to the plural name of the resource. |
| [`width`](#page-width){: #page-width } | `:full \| :record \| :form \| :prose` | `:full` | The width of the views of the page (an intent, `PyroManiac.Dsl.Type.width/0`): `:full` (the whole content area), `:record`, `:form`, or `:prose`. A view can set its own `width`. |
| [`track_presence?`](#page-track_presence?){: #page-track_presence? } | `boolean` | `false` | When true, tracks the users who view this page (a presence of the page) and the users who edit its records (a presence of the resource and the action, shared by every page of the resource). |
| [`custom_filters?`](#page-custom_filters?){: #page-custom_filters? } | `boolean` | `false` | The user builds filters on the filterable fields of each list view (the advanced filter view), in addition to the `search` presets. |
| [`filter_storage`](#page-filter_storage){: #page-filter_storage } | `atom` |  | Where the filters that a user builds are saved: `:client` (in the client, for example the local storage of a browser), or a resource with the `PyroManiac.FilterPresets` extension. Requires `custom_filters? true`. `nil`: not saved. |
| [`delete_preset_confirm`](#page-delete_preset_confirm){: #page-delete_preset_confirm } | `String.t \| false` |  | The confirmation of the delete of a saved filter: a message, or `false` (no confirmation). Required with `filter_storage`: a renderer never adds a confirmation. |
| [`shared_filters?`](#page-shared_filters?){: #page-shared_filters? } | `boolean` | `false` | A user can share a saved filter with other users. Requires a resource in `filter_storage`; its policies control who reads and writes each preset. |
| [`exclude`](#page-exclude){: #page-exclude } | `list(atom)` | `[]` | The actions of the resource that the page does not use. Each exposed action (read, create, update, destroy, generic) is used by a view, or is here. |



### page.extra_action
```elixir
extra_action name
```


Add a custom action to the page toolbar, data table rows, or card actions.

### Nested DSLs
 * [render](#page-extra_action-render)




### Arguments

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`name`](#page-extra_action-name){: #page-extra_action-name .spark-required} | `atom` |  | Unique identifier for this action. |
### Options

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`label`](#page-extra_action-label){: #page-extra_action-label .spark-required} | `String.t` |  | Display label for the action button. |


### page.extra_action.render
```elixir
render renderer, implementation \\ nil
```


A custom render of the node: a text or an Ash expression for every renderer, or an implementation for one renderer.





### Arguments

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`renderer`](#page-extra_action-render-renderer){: #page-extra_action-render-renderer .spark-required} | `any` |  | The renderer library (for example `PyroManiac.LiveView`), or, alone, the portable value: a string or an Ash expression. |
| [`implementation`](#page-extra_action-render-implementation){: #page-extra_action-render-implementation } | `any` |  | The implementation for the renderer. The renderer validates it. |






### Introspection

Target: `PyroManiac.Render`




### Introspection

Target: `PyroManiac.Page.ExtraAction`

### page.description

```elixir
description renderer, implementation \\ nil
```


The description: a text or an Ash expression for every renderer, or an implementation for one renderer.





### Arguments

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`renderer`](#page-description-renderer){: #page-description-renderer .spark-required} | `any` |  | The renderer library (for example `PyroManiac.LiveView`), or, alone, the portable value: a string or an Ash expression. |
| [`implementation`](#page-description-implementation){: #page-description-implementation } | `any` |  | The implementation for the renderer. The renderer validates it. |

### Arguments

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`name`](#views-view-name){: #views-view-name } | `atom \| list(atom)` | `[]` | The action name(s) for this view. |
### Options

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`type`](#views-view-type){: #views-view-type .spark-required} | `:data_table \| :grid \| :card \| :calendar \| :gantt \| :kanban \| :list \| :timeline \| :render` |  | The view type. |
| [`primary?`](#views-view-primary?){: #views-view-primary? } | `boolean` | `false` | The primary view of its kind (a top-level view): the primary single view (a `:card`), or the primary list view. A link to the page opens it. A page has a primary single view; a `:card` that is the only primary view is also the primary list view. |
| [`resource`](#views-view-resource){: #views-view-resource } | `module` |  | Target resource. Defaults to the resource of the page. |
| [`label`](#views-view-label){: #views-view-label } | `String.t` |  | Display label for this view (defaults to capitalized name). |
| [`default_page_size`](#views-view-default_page_size){: #views-view-default_page_size } | `pos_integer` |  | Default page size. Falls back to action's default_limit, then 25. |
| [`page_sizes`](#views-view-page_sizes){: #views-view-page_sizes } | `list(pos_integer)` |  | Available page size options for pagination controls. |
| [`default_sort`](#views-view-default_sort){: #views-view-default_sort } | `String.t \| list({atom, :asc \| :desc \| :asc_nils_first \| :asc_nils_last \| :desc_nils_first \| :desc_nils_last}) \| list(atom) \| list(String.t) \| nil` |  | Default sort specification. Each key is a column, or the rank of the order of the resource (`PyroManiac.Ordering`), shown or not. |
| [`pagination`](#views-view-pagination){: #views-view-pagination } | `:keyset \| :offset \| :none` |  | Pagination type. Auto-detected from resource action if not set. |
| [`count?`](#views-view-count?){: #views-view-count? } | `boolean` |  | Display page count. Defaults to true for offset if allowed. |
| [`read_action`](#views-view-read_action){: #views-view-read_action } | `atom` |  | Override which read action to use on the target resource. |
| [`exclude`](#views-view-exclude){: #views-view-exclude } | `list(atom)` | `[]` | Fields to exclude from this view. |
| [`ensure_loaded`](#views-view-ensure_loaded){: #views-view-ensure_loaded } | `list(atom \| {atom, any})` | `[]` | Ash load statement always applied when loading data for this view, in addition to the loads inferred from columns, fields, and sections. |
| [`on_create`](#views-view-on_create){: #views-view-on_create } | `nil \| :none \| :prepend \| :append \| :reload \| :notify` |  | How to handle PubSub create notifications. |
| [`on_update`](#views-view-on_update){: #views-view-on_update } | `nil \| :none \| :replace \| :reload \| :notify` |  | How to handle PubSub update notifications. |
| [`on_destroy`](#views-view-on_destroy){: #views-view-on_destroy } | `nil \| :none \| :remove \| :reload \| :notify` |  | How to handle PubSub destroy notifications. |
| [`on_bulk`](#views-view-on_bulk){: #views-view-on_bulk } | `nil \| :none \| :reload \| :notify` |  | How to handle a `PyroManiac.Realtime.Bulk` message (one message for a bulk operation). The resource needs `bulk` in its `realtime` section. |
| [`selectable?`](#views-view-selectable?){: #views-view-selectable? } | `boolean` | `true` | Enable the selection of records for bulk actions (list views). |
| [`default_display`](#views-view-default_display){: #views-view-default_display } | `list(atom)` |  | Which columns are visible by default (`:data_table` only). |
| [`group_by`](#views-view-group_by){: #views-view-group_by } | `atom` |  | Field to group records into swimlanes (`:kanban` and optionally `:gantt`). |
| [`kanban_action`](#views-view-kanban_action){: #views-view-kanban_action } | `atom` |  | Update action for kanban card moves (`:kanban` only). Must accept both the `group_by` and `priority` fields. |
| [`priority`](#views-view-priority){: #views-view-priority } | `atom` |  | The string attribute for card ordering within lanes (a fractional index, `:kanban` only). Set from the `priority` of the `kan_ban` section of the resource. Sets `default_sort` automatically. |
| [`date_field`](#views-view-date_field){: #views-view-date_field } | `atom` |  | Field for the date or the start of an event (`:calendar` and `:timeline`). |
| [`end_date_field`](#views-view-end_date_field){: #views-view-end_date_field } | `atom` |  | Field for the end of an event (`:calendar` and `:timeline`, optional: a span). |
| [`granularity`](#views-view-granularity){: #views-view-granularity } | `:day \| :week \| :month` |  | The period that the calendar opens with: `:day`, `:week`, or `:month` (`:calendar` only). The user switches between the three. |
| [`orientation`](#views-view-orientation){: #views-view-orientation } | `:horizontal \| :vertical` |  | The axis of the view (`:timeline` and `:kanban` only). A timeline: `:vertical` (the events from top to bottom, the default) or `:horizontal` (the events from left to right, on a scrollable time axis). A board: `:horizontal` (the lanes side by side, the default) or `:vertical` (the lanes stacked as rows, the cards of each lane from left to right). Set to the default of the type by the transformer. |
| [`width`](#views-view-width){: #views-view-width } | `:full \| :record \| :form \| :prose` |  | The width of the view (an intent, `PyroManiac.Dsl.Type.width/0`): `:full`, `:record`, `:form`, or `:prose`. A `:card` with `presentation :modal` or `:drawer`: the width of its modal or its drawer. `nil`: `:record` for the modal or the drawer of a card, else the width of the page (`PyroManiac.Info.view_width/2`). |
| [`step_orientation`](#views-view-step_orientation){: #views-view-step_orientation } | `:horizontal \| :vertical` | `:horizontal` | The axis of the stepper of the `step` entities of the forms of the view: `:horizontal` (the steps in a row, the default) or `:vertical` (the steps in a column at the side). An `action` can set its own. |
| [`start_field`](#views-view-start_field){: #views-view-start_field } | `atom` |  | Field for task start date (`:gantt` only). |
| [`end_field`](#views-view-end_field){: #views-view-end_field } | `atom` |  | Field for task end date (`:gantt` only). |
| [`progress_field`](#views-view-progress_field){: #views-view-progress_field } | `atom` |  | Field for completion percentage (`:gantt` only, optional). |
| [`parent_field`](#views-view-parent_field){: #views-view-parent_field } | `atom` |  | The `belongs_to` of a record to its parent, on the same resource: the list is a tree (`:list` only, optional). |
| [`loads`](#views-view-loads){: #views-view-loads } | `any` | `[]` | Ash load statement for `:render` views. |
| [`reorder?`](#views-view-reorder?){: #views-view-reorder? } | `boolean` | `false` | The user drags the records to reorder them, when the list is sorted by the rank of the resource (`PyroManiac.Ordering`). `:data_table`, `:grid`, and `:list` views. |
| [`clone?`](#views-view-clone?){: #views-view-clone? } | `boolean` | `false` | A **Clone** action for each record: a create form with the values of the record. The view names a create action (`action`). |
| [`new_row?`](#views-view-new_row?){: #views-view-new_row? } | `boolean` | `false` | An inline new row at the top of the table (`:data_table` only). The view names a create action, and each required input of it is the inline edit of a column (`column ... do action :create do ... end end`). |
| [`card?`](#views-view-card?){: #views-view-card? } | `boolean` | `false` | Each card of the grid shows the tree of the primary `:card` of the page, in view mode: the nodes before `tabs`, without `related` and `attachments` (`:grid` only). Without it, the grid has its own record tree. |
| [`presentation`](#views-view-presentation){: #views-view-presentation } | `:modal \| :drawer \| :page` | `:modal` | How the card opens (`:card` only): `:modal` over the page, `:drawer` at the side of the page, or `:page` on the full page without the list. |


### views.view.description
```elixir
description renderer, implementation \\ nil
```


The description: a text or an Ash expression for every renderer, or an implementation for one renderer.





### Arguments

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`renderer`](#views-view-description-renderer){: #views-view-description-renderer .spark-required} | `any` |  | The renderer library (for example `PyroManiac.LiveView`), or, alone, the portable value: a string or an Ash expression. |
| [`implementation`](#views-view-description-implementation){: #views-view-description-implementation } | `any` |  | The implementation for the renderer. The renderer validates it. |






### Introspection

Target: `PyroManiac.Description`



A link to another page: the single view of a record, or a list view.

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`page`](#views-view-column-link_to-page){: #views-view-column-link_to-page .spark-required} | `atom` |  | The PyroManiac page. Its resource is the destination of the relationship. |
### Options

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`single_view`](#views-view-column-link_to-single_view){: #views-view-column-link_to-single_view } | `atom` |  | The single view of a record (a `:card` view). Defaults to the primary single view. |
| [`open`](#views-view-column-link_to-open){: #views-view-column-link_to-open } | `:navigate \| :stack \| :replace` | `:navigate` | How a click on a record opens it: `:navigate` (the default: the page of the record), `:stack` (its card in a new layer over the current page or layer), or `:replace` (its card in place of the top layer). The link to all the records (a list view) always navigates. |
| [`presentation`](#views-view-column-link_to-presentation){: #views-view-column-link_to-presentation } | `:modal \| :drawer` |  | The shape of a layer (`:stack`, `:replace`): `:modal` or `:drawer`. Defaults to the `presentation` of the card of the page (a card with `presentation :page` opens as a modal). |
| [`list_view`](#views-view-column-link_to-list_view){: #views-view-column-link_to-list_view } | `atom` |  | The list view of all the related records (a relationship to many records only). Defaults to the primary list view. |

### Arguments

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`name`](#views-view-column-action-name){: #views-view-column-action-name .spark-required} | `atom \| list(atom)` |  | The action name(s) for this form. |
| [`state`](#views-view-column-action-state){: #views-view-column-action-state .spark-required} | `:guard \| :recover \| :discard` |  | What happens to the unsaved inputs of the form (renderers must implement it): `:guard` warns before the user leaves with unsaved changes, `:recover` keeps the inputs and restores them after a reload or a lost connection, `:discard` does neither. Required, with no default: the optional second argument (`action :update, :guard`) or an option in the block. |
### Options

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`label`](#views-view-column-action-label){: #views-view-column-action-label } | `String.t` |  | The label for this form (defaults to capitalized name). |
| [`confirm`](#views-view-column-action-confirm){: #views-view-column-action-confirm } | `any` |  | Ask the user to confirm before the action runs: a text, or an Ash expression on the record (and `^arg(:name)` for the inputs) that gives the message (`nil`: no confirmation), or `false` for no confirmation. Required for an action without inputs. |
| [`max_columns`](#views-view-column-action-max_columns){: #views-view-column-action-max_columns } | `pos_integer` |  | The maximum number of columns of the form. |
| [`presentation`](#views-view-column-action-presentation){: #views-view-column-action-presentation } | `:modal \| :drawer \| :page` | `:modal` | How the form of an action with its own tree opens: `:modal`, `:drawer`, or `:page`. |
| [`width`](#views-view-column-action-width){: #views-view-column-action-width } | `:full \| :record \| :form \| :prose` |  | The width of the modal or the drawer of an action with its own tree (an intent, `PyroManiac.Dsl.Type.width/0`): `:full`, `:record`, `:form`, or `:prose`. `nil`: `:record` (`PyroManiac.Info.action_width/1`). |
| [`step_orientation`](#views-view-column-action-step_orientation){: #views-view-column-action-step_orientation } | `:horizontal \| :vertical` |  | The axis of the stepper of the `step` entities of the form: `:horizontal` or `:vertical`. `nil`: the `step_orientation` of the view. |
| [`resource`](#views-view-column-action-resource){: #views-view-column-action-resource } | `module` |  | Target a different resource for this form. Enables cross-resource actions (e.g., creating a child record from a parent data table). |
| [`delegate_to`](#views-view-column-action-delegate_to){: #views-view-column-action-delegate_to } | `module` |  | Resolve fields from a matching action in another pyro_maniac module. Mutually exclusive with inline field definitions. |

| [`empty_text`](#views-view-column-action-field-empty_text){: #views-view-column-action-field-empty_text } | `String.t` | `"—"` | The text in view mode when the value is `nil`. |

### Arguments

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`name`](#views-view-action-name){: #views-view-action-name .spark-required} | `atom \| list(atom)` |  | The action name(s) for this form. |
| [`state`](#views-view-action-state){: #views-view-action-state .spark-required} | `:guard \| :recover \| :discard` |  | What happens to the unsaved inputs of the form (renderers must implement it): `:guard` warns before the user leaves with unsaved changes, `:recover` keeps the inputs and restores them after a reload or a lost connection, `:discard` does neither. Required, with no default: the optional second argument (`action :update, :guard`) or an option in the block. |
### Options

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`label`](#views-view-action-label){: #views-view-action-label } | `String.t` |  | The label for this form (defaults to capitalized name). |
| [`confirm`](#views-view-action-confirm){: #views-view-action-confirm } | `any` |  | Ask the user to confirm before the action runs: a text, or an Ash expression on the record (and `^arg(:name)` for the inputs) that gives the message (`nil`: no confirmation), or `false` for no confirmation. Required for an action without inputs. |
| [`max_columns`](#views-view-action-max_columns){: #views-view-action-max_columns } | `pos_integer` |  | The maximum number of columns of the form. |
| [`presentation`](#views-view-action-presentation){: #views-view-action-presentation } | `:modal \| :drawer \| :page` | `:modal` | How the form of an action with its own tree opens: `:modal`, `:drawer`, or `:page`. |
| [`width`](#views-view-action-width){: #views-view-action-width } | `:full \| :record \| :form \| :prose` |  | The width of the modal or the drawer of an action with its own tree (an intent, `PyroManiac.Dsl.Type.width/0`): `:full`, `:record`, `:form`, or `:prose`. `nil`: `:record` (`PyroManiac.Info.action_width/1`). |
| [`step_orientation`](#views-view-action-step_orientation){: #views-view-action-step_orientation } | `:horizontal \| :vertical` |  | The axis of the stepper of the `step` entities of the form: `:horizontal` or `:vertical`. `nil`: the `step_orientation` of the view. |
| [`resource`](#views-view-action-resource){: #views-view-action-resource } | `module` |  | Target a different resource for this form. Enables cross-resource actions (e.g., creating a child record from a parent data table). |
| [`delegate_to`](#views-view-action-delegate_to){: #views-view-action-delegate_to } | `module` |  | Resolve fields from a matching action in another pyro_maniac module. Mutually exclusive with inline field definitions. |

| [`label_key`](#views-view-action-combobox-label_key){: #views-view-action-combobox-label_key } | `atom` |  | The text of an option. Select mode: defaults to the `default_label` of the destination. Free text: always `value_key`. |

Defaults to `[label_key]`. `false` when `filter` uses `^search()` or an `argument` uses `search()`. |
| [`filter`](#views-view-action-section-combobox-filter){: #views-view-action-section-combobox-filter } | `any` |  | An additional filter (an Ash expression), joined with `and`. It can use `^search()`, `^input(:name)`, and `^actor(...)`. |
| [`sort`](#views-view-action-section-combobox-sort){: #views-view-action-section-combobox-sort } | `keyword` |  | The order of the options. Defaults to `[{label_key, :asc}]`. |
| [`limit`](#views-view-action-section-combobox-limit){: #views-view-action-section-combobox-limit } | `pos_integer` | `20` | The maximum number of options, from 1 to 100. |

| [`value_key`](#views-view-action-section-combobox-value_key){: #views-view-action-section-combobox-value_key } | `atom` |  | The value of an option. Select mode: defaults to the primary key of the destination. Free text: defaults to the name of the field. |

| [`delegate_to`](#views-view-bulk_action-delegate_to){: #views-view-bulk_action-delegate_to } | `module` |  | Resolve fields from a matching bulk action in another pyro_maniac module. Mutually exclusive with inline field definitions. |

| [`presentation`](#views-view-edit_columns-compound-combobox-link_to-presentation){: #views-view-edit_columns-compound-combobox-link_to-presentation } | `:modal \| :drawer` |  | The shape of a layer (`:stack`, `:replace`): `:modal` or `:drawer`. Defaults to the `presentation` of the card of the page (a card with `presentation :page` opens as a modal). |
| [`list_view`](#views-view-edit_columns-compound-combobox-link_to-list_view){: #views-view-edit_columns-compound-combobox-link_to-list_view } | `atom` |  | The list view of all the related records (a relationship to many records only). Defaults to the primary list view. |

## searches
Configure simple search forms for the tabbed filter UI.

### Nested DSLs
 * [search](#searches-search)
   * field





### searches.search
```elixir
search name
```


Declare a search tab for the tabbed filter UI.

### Nested DSLs
 * [field](#searches-search-field)




### Arguments

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`name`](#searches-search-name){: #searches-search-name .spark-required} | `atom` |  | Search identifier. |
### Options

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`interactive?`](#searches-search-interactive?){: #searches-search-interactive? } | `boolean` | `true` | When false, all inputs are rendered disabled (read-only search tab). |
| [`label`](#searches-search-label){: #searches-search-label } | `String.t` |  | Tab label (defaults to humanized name). |
| [`operator`](#searches-search-operator){: #searches-search-operator } | `:and \| :or` | `:and` | How field predicates combine (:and or :or). |


### searches.search.field
```elixir
field name
```


Declare a field in the search form.





### Arguments

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`name`](#searches-search-field-name){: #searches-search-field-name .spark-required} | `atom` |  | Field identifier. |
### Options

| Name | Type | Default | Docs |
|------|------|---------|------|
| [`label`](#searches-search-field-label){: #searches-search-field-label } | `String.t` |  | Input label (defaults to humanized name). |
| [`negated?`](#searches-search-field-negated?){: #searches-search-field-negated? } | `boolean` | `false` | Negate the field's predicate (e.g. `not contains`). |
| [`operator`](#searches-search-field-operator){: #searches-search-field-operator } | `atom` | `:contains` | Operator for predicates. |
| [`source`](#searches-search-field-source){: #searches-search-field-source } | `list(atom \| list(atom))` |  | Source fields/paths to search across (defaults to [name]). Values are OR'd. |
| [`value`](#searches-search-field-value){: #searches-search-field-value } | `any` |  | Default value to pre-fill the field. |





### Introspection

Target: `PyroManiac.Search.Field`
